pts: First and only product designer for a clinic-management (EHR) SaaS. Built the dashboard and marketing site from the ground up and own them end to end.
Led a full revamp for a new feature set: consultation suite, dental charting, AI inbox and analytics, made clear for non-technical staff.
Built a mini design system that keeps the product consistent and speeds up handoff.
Refreshed the marketing site with glassmorphism, micro-interactions and motion; kept the dashboard clean and function-first.
Founded and ran a creative studio for brand, social and video content: strategy, scripting, direction, design and delivery.
Owned client relationships end to end for 3 clients: scoping, content, timelines and final delivery.
Built an AI-augmented production workflow (Claude, ChatGPT, generative image and video tools).
Owned design for core learner-facing areas of a global EdTech platform in 15+ countries, shaping roadmap, release sequencing and UX strategy.
Led an end-to-end mobile app revamp: research, competitive analysis and high-fidelity prototypes for a faster beta.
Built and maintained a mobile + web design system on Atomic Design principles.
Led the full rebrand from SwimNGo to Swimingo: new visual identity and design system for a D2C platform serving swim academies.
Ran A/B tests, design sprints and stakeholder workshops to drive data-informed UX improvements.
Designed web and mobile experiences for an internal financial-operations platform: travel-spend management, multi-step approvals and expense visibility.
Simplified booking and approval-routing flows with the product owner to cut friction and speed up task completion.
Built user-facing frontend interfaces alongside designers and engineers. The cross-functional exposure is what led me into full-time product design.
